notes: קֹרְאָיו takes the supplied 'them that' its anarthrous substantival rendering needs (rule 46) together with the 'upon' by which the English verb reaches its object suffix (rule 44), headed on the word carrying the lexeme; the suffix keeps only 'him' under rule 18.
In the second colon the written אֲשֶׁר takes the 'that' under rule 46's first rider, a present morpheme taking its English before a supplied reading does.
